lines.text: Use a short explanation, demonstration and later revisit to understand one learning goal without turning a handful of answers into a diagnosis.

items.text: Write the exact skill or idea you want to observe.
Choose a familiar example and a related new example.
Ask for a response without supplying the answer in your question.
Invite a reason, drawing or demonstration where appropriate.
Record prompts, tools and other help used, not only right or wrong.
Give feedback or reteach the specific gap.

line.text: A check of eight questions you supply and mark, reported one topic at a time, including the honest answer that there is not enough to say.
